name: jewelora
description: AI jewellery virtual try-on and smart jewellery commerce platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && cd backend && .venv/bin/ruff check . ../ai ../scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && cd backend && .venv/bin/mypy app ../ai/jewelora_ai
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
